cancellation.confirmed_red: Pointer chooser and visible Cancel after focused width text reproduces an unintended project revision, width and pending grain commit on the first unguarded post-close blur.
cancellation.first_guard_attempt: Always stamping one frame suppresses the first post-close pass but still fails the second; retained in green.log and guard-diagnostic.log.
cancellation.root_cause: egui keeps the previous modal layer until the first post-dismissal pass ends; the restored background field loses focus on that pass, and lost_focus remains true through one further pass. The original helper omitted same-ID/current-none guards, while callers inconsistently stamped separately.
cancellation.fix: The shared action helper always stores an explicit expiry for affected numeric IDs: through the next frame normally, through the second post-action frame while a modal layer exists. Existing successful cache clearing/failure restoration stays; export/prepare duplicate stamps removed; sewing cancellation routes through this helper after its existing current-focus surrender.
